verdict.why:
The draft holds: all of its counts match my independent run, its empty mark set is complete, and nothing it claims could be falsified. My scripts did not reuse the draft's ledger.mjs. They are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-mashiachsonyosef-github-io/c72302ec-11e7-5b6d-a5ab-47bb077585fe/scratchpad/punct/verify/muse_hebrew_english_ground_truth_dictionary/: verify.mjs writes verify-result.json, and probe.mjs writes probe-result.json. Both are single-process and read one provider file.

(a) Counts: 0 mismatches across about 50 checked figures. The file has 24,514 rows on 20,057 keys: 23,065 under M6 and 1,449 under M62. Every route is its whole definition (whole 24,514, slice 0, absent 0). Routes per key are 1:16,503, 2:2,800, 3:624, 4:112, 5:17 and 6:1. 3,554 keys carry more than one route, with 8,011 routes between them. No key mixes M6 and M62 and no key+route pair repeats. Route lengths are 1-3:1,007, 4-10:21,762 and 11-20:1,745. 135 routes carry a non-ASCII letter, using 30 distinct characters. Two rows carry the year 2026 (מחל: forgive and טבילה: immersion). Every evidence example the draft gives matches the file, including that מורשה carries both "authorised" and "authorized" as separate records. The mark inventory's rows for M6 and M62 (mark_count 0, all whole) and the ranked file's entry (24,514 routes, cc_by_nc_4_0) also agree.

(b) Completeness: under the stated test (any character not a letter, digit or whitespace) there are 0 marks in route text, 0 in definition text and 0 in keys. 0 shapes are declared, 0 occurrences exist and none goes unexplained.

(c) Falsification: no mark divides anything, so there is no dividing shape to falsify. I probed the draft's claims instead, and none failed.
- Marks hidden inside the inventory's "letter" or "whitespace" categories: non-ASCII whitespace 0 (no-break space, byte-order mark), invisible format characters 0, modifier letters 0, combining marks 0, non-Latin letters 0, routes not in precomposed form 0.
- All 30 non-ASCII characters are lowercase precomposed Latin letters (144 occurrences), as the draft says.
- Uppercase 0 and title case 0, so the lowercase claim holds.
- "Every route is one word": 0 routes contain whitespace. I split the 10+ letter routes into pairs of other routes in this file; that found 238, and all are single English words or morphology (convict+ions, inter+national). None is a fused phrase.
- Dropped apostrophes: only 3 routes look like contraction stems (מזהה: id, זיהוי: id, אים: im), and none is plainly a contraction.
- The machine (declaration-v1.mjs) computes unknownMarks before it checks separates_on, so the draft's closure refusal describes what the code does. With the store's current declarations it returns all 24,514 routes whole.

(d) v3 comparison, re-run with the real senseSplit plus a depth-0 ';' split: 24,514 fields compared and 24,514 divided the same way. Every other category is 0: v3 dividing where the declaration keeps whole, the reverse, dividing differently, v3 withholding, printing differently while both are whole, and unknown-mark rows.

Two notes, neither changing the verdict:
- The "alternatives" rule says a second word is a second record, but its "governs" figure of 8,011 counts every record on a multi-route key. Read literally, the rule covers only the 4,457 records after the first on each key. The 8,011 figure is internally consistent with the census.
- The alternatives on one key are not all synonyms. 140 pairs are inflections of the same word (נופש: resort | resorts), 9 differ by s/z spelling (מורשה: authorised | authorized), and one is a sound-alike (הולם: holm). The draft never claims they are synonyms.

The declaration also carries five fields the August M14 declaration does not have (declared_on, regions, conventions_without_marks, separates_on_why, falsifiers). The machine never reads them, so they have no effect on the page. The one British spelling in it, "authorised", is quoted from the source, which CLAUDE.md allows.

questions: Should we merge a declaration whose mark set is empty, or leave MUSE undeclared? (A) Merge it: the 24,514 routes are declared with an empty closed set. A mark that shows up in a later store is then reported through the machine's unknownMarks, and its row ships whole. (B) Leave it undeclared: the default already ships all 24,514 routes whole, and a mark that shows up later ships whole with no report. Either way, no card changes today (0 of 24,514). The only difference is whether a future mark gets reported.

This one is not about marks; I found it in passing. 2 rows carry year '2026' where the other 24,512 carry S_NO_SOURCE_YEAR: מחל 'forgive' and טבילה 'immersion', both M6. (A) 2026 is the provider's own year, and the rows stay dated witnesses. (B) It is an ingest stamp this project wrote, and the rows should read S_NO_SOURCE_YEAR like the rest. The data cannot tell which. It affects 2 rows.
